_comment: Hugging Face dataset revisions the semantic_intent classifier was last trained against. This file is the AUTHORITATIVE pin — tooling reads it and only it. The scheduled workflow .github/workflows/dataset-monitor.yml compares these to the live revisions and opens an issue when a source updates. When you retrain against a newer revision, bump the sha HERE and also update the matching '**Pinned revision:**' line in data-raw/SOURCES.md, which restates these values in prose for human readers; scripts/check_dataset_revisions.py asserts the two agree and exits 2 if they drift.
